steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "cat > /data/local/tmp/broccoli_dedupe.sh <<'SH'
#!/system/bin/sh
db=/data/user/0/com.flauschcode.broccoli/databases/broccoli
echo DUPS_BEFORE
sqlite3 -header -csv "$db" "SELECT title,imageName,description,servings,preparationTime,source,ingredients,directions,favorite,COUNT(*) AS cnt,GROUP_CONCAT(recipeId) AS ids FROM recipes GROUP BY title,imageName,description,servings,preparationTime,source,ingredients,directions,favorite HAVING COUNT(*)>1;"
echo ---
sqlite3 "$db" <<'SQL'
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE _dups AS
SELECT r1.recipeId
FROM recipes r1
JOIN recipes r2
  ON r1.recipeId > r2.recipeId
 AND IFNULL(r1.title,'')=IFNULL(r2.title,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.imageName,'')=IFNULL(r2.imageName,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.description,'')=IFNULL(r2.description,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.servings,'')=IFNULL(r2.servings,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.preparationTime,'')=IFNULL(r2.preparationTime,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.source,'')=IFNULL(r2.source,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.ingredients,'')=IFNULL(r2.ingredients,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.directions,'')=IFNULL(r2.directions,'')
 AND IFNULL(r1.favorite,0)=IFNULL(r2.favorite,0);
DELETE FROM recipes_with_categories WHERE recipeId IN (SELECT recipeId FROM _dups);
DELETE FROM recipes WHERE recipeId IN (SELECT recipeId FROM _dups);
SELECT 'deleted', COUNT(*) FROM _dups;
DROP TABLE _dups;
COMMIT;
SQL
echo ---
echo DUPS_AFTER
sqlite3 -header -csv "$db" "SELECT title,imageName,description,servings,preparationTime,source,ingredients,directions,favorite,COUNT(*) AS cnt,GROUP_CONCAT(recipeId) AS ids FROM recipes GROUP BY title,imageName,description,servings,preparationTime,source,ingredients,directions,favorite HAVING COUNT(*)>1;"
echo ---
echo TOTAL_AFTER
sqlite3 "$db" "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes;"
SH
su 0 sh /data/local/tmp/broccoli_dedupe.sh; am force-stop com.flauschcode.broccoli; rm -f /data/local/tmp/broccoli_dedupe.sh"
